project.name: osgi/jgiven/jgiven-wrap
project.description: jgiven-core + jgiven-junit5 (2.0.3) wrapped as a first-class OSGi bundle. EVERY jgiven dependency already carries a Bundle-SymbolicName (guava, gson, paranamer, jansi, jakarta.annotation, byte-buddy) and slf4j is owned by pax-logging — so there is no not-designed-for-OSGi tail to embed. The wrap is maximally LOCAL: stamp OSGi headers onto the only two header-less jars (the jgiven pair), export com.tngtech.jgiven.*, and Import-Package everything else so each dependency installs as its own pre-existing bundle. Test-scope only — no production bundle imports jGiven.
